text:
Emilia Novak: Hi team — onboarding snag. Im an international hire (work visa) and I added my spouse for benefits but the portal says "pending eligibility review". Also my relocation lump sum reimbursement hasn't hit my payroll yet. Who handles visa-dependent eligibility and relocation payments?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Emilia! For spouse eligibility on visa cases we need immigration docs + marriage proof; GlobalHR does the verification for benefits eligibility. Relocation reimbursements are handled by People Ops but run through payroll as a taxable lump sum. Tagging Sanya and Liam.

Sanya (Benefits): Emilia, can you DM the date of marriage and confirm spouse's country? Some carriers need additional forms for non-US dependents. If spouse is not US-based, we may need to set up international dependent billing or decline coverage depending on carrier rules.

Emilia Novak: DM sent with marriage date 2024-05-01 and spouse is currently in Poland but will join me in SF in July. I uploaded the certificate to BambooHR on 2024-06-22 under "Supporting Docs".

GlobalHR Bot: Document received: "Novak_Emilia_spouse_05012024.pdf". Queued for verification. Ticket GH-3421 created.

Sanya (Benefits): I see GH-3421. Carriers differ: MedCarrierA allows foreign-domiciled dependents if they will be US residents; they want an attestation of intent to relocate. I can request an exception once GlobalHR confirms expected arrival date. Please add a short note in the BambooHR doc field stating expected relocation date.

Emilia Novak: Done  added note: "Spouse expected arrival USA 2024-07-15".

Sanya (Benefits): Great, I requested expedited review. If approved, coverage effective date will be 2024-07-15 (first day spouse is US resident). If carrier denies, we'll discuss alternatives (short-term coverage or separate enrollment).

Liam (Payroll): Regarding relocation: we received People Ops approval for the lump-sum payment on 2024-06-20. Payroll cycle timing means it should appear on the 06/30 run. If you don't see it by 07/02, DM me. Note: taxable treatment applied and a supplemental tax withholding was selected per your form.

Emilia Novak: I checked my 06/30 paystub and don't see the lump sum or any supplemental withholding. It shows the regular salary only.

Liam (Payroll): Hmm. I'll pull the batch. Can you confirm the Relocation Authorization ID from the relocation portal?

Emilia Novak: ID R-7782. I also received an approval email from People Ops on 06/20.

Liam (Payroll): Found the issue  the relocation file was sent after the payroll cutoff due to a missing IRS-supplemental checkbox. I updated the payroll entry manually and pushed a correction. You should see a supplemental line item and the payment on a special off-cycle run scheduled 07/01. Expect funds by 07/02 depending on bank. Apologies for the delay.

Emilia Novak: Thank you! One last thing  if spouse coverage is approved backdated to 07/15, will premium be prorated or will there be retro deductions?

Sanya (Benefits): Premiums are charged from effective date; if enrollment is retro to 07/15 and payroll already ran, payroll will do a retro deduction in the next cycle to collect any missed premiums. We'll try to align timing to avoid big catch-up whenever possible.

Emilia Novak: Perfect, appreciate the speedy help everyone.

Ava (People Ops): Summary: GlobalHR verifying docs for visa-dependent (GH-3421). Sanya requested expedited carrier review; if approved effective 07/15. Liam scheduled off-cycle relocation payment for 07/01. If anything changes ping @people-ops or file GH-3421.
